mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the new surface was most worthwhile: it showed that closing the gap is not the same as restoring strength underneath.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the support fibres was predictable from the item pictures, so it felt more like a necessary preparation than an interesting decision.

surprise.text: The capillary sprout had to meet another vessel before the picture showed blood flowing through it; that made the new branch's purpose clearer.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though the remaining combinations at steps 4, 7 and 8 were the only ones offered rather than meaningful choices.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see how another body process connects to this repair, though the predictable fittings made the gameplay less compelling than the biology.
